The batch therefore emphasizes local curves and loading contrasts around the remaining catastrophic P/O, nitrobenzophenone, oxygen-rich, donor, and aromatic-aldehyde regions.","batch_rationale":"The batch repairs several recurrent failure regions while preserving generalization controls. It contains local condition and loading curves for nitrobenzophenone, charged P/O, oxygen-rich beta-ketoester and multi-carbonyl families, enamines, donor phenols, pyridyl esters, and acids. The m177 and m202 series test nonlinear transitions near measured catastrophic endpoints; the m107 and m13 series target late V2 tails; and m209, m72, m90, m117, and m125 extend family-specific response curves. m70, m215, m114, and m104 provide neutral or compact controls that constrain correction leakage. Together these labels cover onset, completion, interval width, ratio transitions, and conditional loading effects across chemically distinct regions that recur throughout the Row-distribution."}
